title: Driftline
summary: An ocean-research decision workspace that makes stalled work, ownership gaps, and opportunities for support visible.
intro: Driftline translates lessons from proprietary research-product work into a fictional public demonstration of transparent attention routing and human-centered support.

heroImage.alt: Driftline dashboard showing portfolio flow across signals, evaluations, programs, and field operations

role: Product strategy · Research synthesis · Interaction design · Design system · Engineering

designSystem.name: Driftline
designSystem.summary: A portable product method expressed as a precise ocean-research instrument: calm enough to scan, explicit enough to act.

principles.name: Make flow visible
principles.description: Movement and blockage appear before secondary metrics so the state of the portfolio is immediately legible.

principles.name: Explain the prompt
principles.description: Every intervention names its rule, evidence, age, owner, and the condition that will clear it.

principles.name: Preserve human judgment
principles.description: The system routes attention while people retain responsibility for deciding, delegating, and offering support.

principles.name: Earn the density
principles.description: Compact operational information stays readable, structured, keyboard-accessible, and resilient at smaller viewports.

typography.description: A compact sans serif carries dense operational hierarchy without making the workspace feel administrative.
Rules, identifiers, stages, timestamps, and system status read like a precise research instrument.

components.name: Actions
components.description: Primary, quiet, and unavailable actions establish hierarchy while preserving native control behavior.

components.name: Status
components.description: Text, icon, and color carry movement, waiting, and blocked meaning together.

components.name: Selection
components.description: Pressed state remains visible and exposed to assistive technology across portfolio filters.

componentSnapshot.alt: Driftline design-system specimens showing action controls, status badges, and selection controls
componentSnapshot.caption: Actions, status, and selection captured from the Driftline system specimen.

productProof.title: The handoff becomes the interface
productProof.description: Lifecycle flow, attention queues, and role lenses connect portfolio state to a specific person, explanation, and next action.

image.alt: Driftline portfolio workspace showing stage totals, filters, and research records in the viewer's system theme

accessibility.title: Operational density remains navigable
accessibility.description: Native controls, visible labels, pressed states, 44px targets, reduced motion, forced-color support, and 200% reflow are treated as system constraints.

internalNotes: The public demo is a one-week proof of concept informed by proprietary professional work. Its organization, people, portfolio data, and ocean-research scenario are fictional. Driftline itself has not undergone user testing; do not imply it is a public replica of the work product or attach outcomes from testing conducted at Pete's employer.
